verification: Contract fixtures round-trip and strict validation rejects inconsistent schema versions.

scope: Build three-pane inbox, transcript, contact context, follow-up status and mobile drilldown.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Agent/owner can find and inspect a thread with accurate sender/time/delivery labels.
verification: Agent/owner can find and inspect a thread with accurate sender/time/delivery labels.

units.title: Versioned outbound draft pipeline
scope: Create model/human-authored drafts with source evidence, headers, recipients, variables and expiry.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Owner can edit content; AI-generated text not mislabeled as verified fact.
verification: Owner can edit content; AI-generated text not mislabeled as verified fact.

units.title: Owner message composer and approvals
scope: Implement rich/plain-text preview, reply/forward, attachment selection and exact-message owner approval.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Content edits invalidate previously approved sends; focus and paste are safe on mobile.
verification: Content edits invalidate previously approved sends; focus and paste are safe on mobile.

units.title: Least-privilege outbound email transport gateway
scope: Implement authorized email send with provider idempotency key, sender validation, policy recheck and secure receipt.
units.acceptanceCriteria: No send unless all current approval, suppression, domain, budget and identity conditions hold.
verification: No send unless all current approval, suppression, domain, budget and identity conditions hold.

units.title: Outbound status, retries and ambiguity quarantine
scope: Capture provider accepted/bounced/failed receipts and uncertain-send reconciliation.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Transport timeout does not create a second email; unmatched responses need owner reconciliation.
verification: Transport timeout does not create a second email; unmatched responses need owner reconciliation.

units.title: Unsubscribe headers and cross-campaign opt-out ingestion
scope: Add required unsubscribe mechanisms, tenant postal-address config and high-priority suppression processing.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Opt-out immediately blocks pending sequences and is auditable; no sender launch if required profile missing.
verification: Opt-out immediately blocks pending sequences and is auditable; no sender launch if required profile missing.

units.title: Bounce, spam complaint and sender health controls
scope: Record delivery failures, complaint rate, domain caps and automatic risk pauses.
units.acceptanceCriteria: High-complaint campaigns pause; known invalid addresses are suppressed.
verification: High-complaint campaigns pause; known invalid addresses are suppressed.

units.title: Reply triage and safe suggested response
scope: Classify interested/not-interested/question/opt-out/ambiguous with uncertainty, owner escalation and citations.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Opt-outs processed deterministically, not dependent solely on model classification; uncertain replies escalate.
verification: Opt-outs processed deterministically, not dependent solely on model classification; uncertain replies escalate.

units.title: Cadenced follow-up sequence scheduler
scope: Schedule authorized follow-ups with max touch count, quiet hours, cancellation on reply and opt-out.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Reply, pause, or suppression before dispatch cancels queued followup without race.
verification: Reply, pause, or suppression before dispatch cancels queued followup without race.

units.title: Human takeover, conversation ownership and SLA
scope: Owner can claim a thread, edit/respond, pause agent, release ownership and prioritize replies.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Agent cannot send while owner owns the conversation unless explicitly delegated.
verification: Agent cannot send while owner owns the conversation unless explicitly delegated.

units.title: Attachment handling, scanning and safe downloads
scope: Scan, store, authorize, render or quarantine inbound and proposal attachments.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Malware, oversized files and forbidden types do not reach model/tool execution.
verification: Malware, oversized files and forbidden types do not reach model/tool execution.

units.title: Simulated end-to-end inbox and send reconciliation
scope: Test full mock response loop, signed events, opt-out, bounce, human takeover and crash mid-send.
units.acceptanceCriteria: All interaction/UI tests pass without a real mailbox, money or customer outreach.
verification: All interaction/UI tests pass without a real mailbox, money or customer outreach.

units.title: Owner-authorized real mailbox canary
scope: With connected test mailbox, verify domain settings, legitimate test recipients, provider receipts and opt-outs.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Live canary evidence recorded; only explicitly enabled sender/test contacts receive messages.
verification: Live canary evidence recorded; only explicitly enabled sender/test contacts receive messages.
externalPrerequisites: Owner-authorized mailbox and sender domain, required physical postal address, configured unsubscribe and lawful test recipient(s).

units.title: Strategy definitions, versioning and constraints
scope: Create strategy families, audience rules, allowed personalization, forbidden claims and immutable revisions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Owner can modify a proposed new revision without mutating historical experiments.
verification: Owner can modify a proposed new revision without mutating historical experiments.

units.title: Strategy Lab cards, sliders and allocation rules
scope: Expose per-campaign champion/experimental percentages (suggested default 50/50) plus configurable min exploration.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Saved sliders change actual allocation rules; no hidden hardcoded split.
verification: Saved sliders change actual allocation rules; no hidden hardcoded split.

units.title: Deterministic randomized experiment enrollment
scope: Enroll eligible lead exactly once per experiment revision, balanced/stratified by segment and campaign.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Repeated workers/runs use same arm and seed; no cross-experiment duplicate exposures.
verification: Repeated workers/runs use same arm and seed; no cross-experiment duplicate exposures.

units.title: Verified exposure and outcome event accounting
scope: Capture sent, reply, qualified response, meeting, deal, funds received, spam and costs with evidence.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Stats cannot count imagined 'closed' or model claims as receipts.
verification: Stats cannot count imagined 'closed' or model claims as receipts.

units.title: Materialized performance metrics and source visibility
scope: Compute per-qualified-outreach margin, cost, conversion, complaint rate and cohort outcomes.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard separates actual vs estimated, currency conversions, periods and denominator sizes.
verification: Dashboard separates actual vs estimated, currency conversions, periods and denominator sizes.

units.title: Confidence intervals, sample floors and false discovery rules
scope: Compute interval/credible comparison, time lag, sample size and guardrails before declaring winner.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Small or imbalanced samples warn; unstable uplift never auto-promotes.
verification: Small or imbalanced samples warn; unstable uplift never auto-promotes.

units.title: Model x strategy factorial comparison
scope: Report model and strategy effects independently, cohort controls, cost and quality metrics.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Model/strategy winner decisions include confounder and selection-bias warnings.
verification: Model/strategy winner decisions include confounder and selection-bias warnings.

units.title: Auditable champion promotion and rollback
scope: Create manual and optionally guarded automatic promotion with version/fingerprint and safety criteria.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Clear evidence required; every promotion can be rolled back and audited.
verification: Clear evidence required; every promotion can be rolled back and audited.

units.title: Experiment strategy hybrids and new-variant backlog
scope: Support strategy variation lineage, mixing proven elements and reserved exploration.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A hybrid is independently evaluated before replacing champion; variants keep identity history.
verification: A hybrid is independently evaluated before replacing champion; variants keep identity history.

units.title: Analytics visualization, funnel and experiment reports
scope: Build conversion funnel, side-by-side strategy cards, cost/outcome charts and provenance drilldown.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Visual reports match ledger and underlying immutable events; empty/small samples explained.
verification: Visual reports match ledger and underlying immutable events; empty/small samples explained.

units.title: Controlled experiment fairness and safety tests
scope: Use large synthetic cohorts, varying deal sizes and timing to test stratification, false positives and stop rules.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A/B testing neither overstates certainty nor violates unsubscribe/budget policies.
verification: A/B testing neither overstates certainty nor violates unsubscribe/budget policies.

units.title: Funding source and grant program directory
scope: Model grants, foundations, sponsors, partnerships, investor funds, source URLs and verified update timestamps.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Owner can filter by geography, eligibility, deadline and type; provenance retained.
verification: Owner can filter by geography, eligibility, deadline and type; provenance retained.

units.title: Funding opportunity discovery connectors
scope: Use permitted public APIs/feeds and manual import with source evidence and refresh policy.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Unavailable APIs yield explicit waiting state; no fabricated program/call for proposals.
verification: Unavailable APIs yield explicit waiting state; no fabricated program/call for proposals.

units.title: Grant eligibility rules and fit explanation
scope: Evaluate applicant/entity type, jurisdiction, stage, restrictions, required documents and program deadlines.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Eligibility unknown is not shown as eligible; every fit result cites a current source.
verification: Eligibility unknown is not shown as eligible; every fit result cites a current source.

units.title: Visual funding pipeline and opportunity cards
scope: Build grant/partner/investor boards with funding range, urgency, eligibility, ownership and source links.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A funding lead, pending award, commitment and received payment are visually distinct.
verification: A funding lead, pending award, commitment and received payment are visually distinct.

units.title: Grant application and task checklist domain
scope: Track draft answers, required documents, milestones, reviews, submission status and evidence.
units.acceptanceCriteria: No application becomes 'submitted' without provider receipt or owner-verified evidence.
verification: No application becomes 'submitted' without provider receipt or owner-verified evidence.

units.title: Grant document repository and source-grounded drafting
scope: Attach organization eligibility proofs and generate reviewable narrative drafts only from verified project facts.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Unsupported organizational claims are blocked; required documents remain private.
verification: Unsupported organizational claims are blocked; required documents remain private.

units.title: Deadline calendar and application reminders
scope: Schedule internal review timelines and owner alerts by deadline/timezone, including stale-program recheck.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Upcoming deadline cards use exact provenance and never silently submit.
verification: Upcoming deadline cards use exact provenance and never silently submit.

units.title: Human-reviewed grant submission workflow
scope: Create eligibility certification, attachments validation, exact submission payload and authorized action gate.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Autonomous agent cannot sign/certify or submit regulated representations without owner approval.
verification: Autonomous agent cannot sign/certify or submit regulated representations without owner approval.

units.title: Award, restriction and disbursement reconciliation
scope: Record offered/accepted award, restriction, payments received and allocations with immutable evidence.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Grant award is not recorded as cash received until verified receipt; restricted funds separated.
verification: Grant award is not recorded as cash received until verified receipt; restricted funds separated.

units.title: Investor relations policy and opportunity pipeline
scope: Add investor organization/meeting/interest records, allowable communications classes and solicitation safeguards.
units.acceptanceCriteria: General solicitation/regulated offer requests are blocked or owner/legal reviewed as required.
verification: General solicitation/regulated offer requests are blocked or owner/legal reviewed as required.

units.title: Investor pitch asset workspace and review
scope: Version source-grounded deck narratives, financial facts, approved investor email copy and diligence checklist.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Fictitious traction/revenue claims fail; all outbound pitch revisions link to approved facts.
verification: Fictitious traction/revenue claims fail; all outbound pitch revisions link to approved facts.

units.title: Commitment, diligence and investment funds bookkeeping
scope: Distinguish meeting/interest/term sheet/signed commitment/cash received and legal status.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard never labels verbal interest as raised money; proof/source requirements enforced.
verification: Dashboard never labels verbal interest as raised money; proof/source requirements enforced.

units.title: Sponsorship and partnership opportunity workflows
scope: Track partner research, proposals, approval, contract review, signed outcomes and funds or service exchanged.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Binding terms require authorized human review; agent cannot autonomously execute contracts.
verification: Binding terms require authorized human review; agent cannot autonomously execute contracts.

units.title: Funding performance and portfolio allocation dashboard
scope: Show applied/eligible/pending/won/received grant outcomes, investor qualified meetings and true net funding.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline and funding amounts reconcile to awards/receipts and exclude forecasts.
verification: Pipeline and funding amounts reconcile to awards/receipts and exclude forecasts.

units.title: Configurable pricing and owner-approved quotation flow
scope: Offer terms, price book revisions, discounts with scoped approvals and sent-quote tracking.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Quotes use current approved price and do not create binding terms without authorization.
verification: Quotes use current approved price and do not create binding terms without authorization.

units.title: Optional payment processor connector foundation
scope: Implement opt-in isolated checkout/payment webhook connector, scoped secrets and signature checks.
units.acceptanceCriteria: No live charges until owner connects separate account and approves plan; sandbox receipts work.
verification: No live charges until owner connects separate account and approves plan; sandbox receipts work.

units.title: Payments, refunds, disputes and subscription receipts
scope: Reconcile transactions, chargebacks, taxes/fees if applicable, cancellations and immutable ledger entries.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Actual net realized revenue is computed from verified processor events, not claimed in an email.
verification: Actual net realized revenue is computed from verified processor events, not claimed in an email.

units.title: Renewals and post-sale retention workflows
scope: Track lawful customer onboarding, renewals, trial completion, service escalations and churn outcomes.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Customer support ownership and suppression are respected; churn/revenue metrics use recorded evidence.
verification: Customer support ownership and suppression are respected; churn/revenue metrics use recorded evidence.

units.title: Calendar and meeting scheduling adapters
scope: Add provider-neutral calendar availability and authorized meeting creation, edits and cancellations.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A sales agent cannot access unrelated calendars or create a meeting without delegated permission.
verification: A sales agent cannot access unrelated calendars or create a meeting without delegated permission.

units.title: CRM import/export and external sync connectors
scope: Provide scoped CSV/API exports plus optional third-party CRM mapping and reconcile loops.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Stable external IDs and conflict ownership prevent duplication and cross-tenant leakage.
verification: Stable external IDs and conflict ownership prevent duplication and cross-tenant leakage.

units.title: Opt-in website lead form and inbound widget
scope: Capture permissioned inbound contact intents via authenticated/anti-abuse form endpoints.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Spam and replay filtered; lead consent and provenance recorded with retention.
verification: Spam and replay filtered; lead consent and provenance recorded with retention.

units.title: Client/account dashboard and invoices view
scope: Display invoice/payment status, contract evidence and contact history in owner-approved views.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Customer-facing routes expose only intended tenant/account data; no internal model transcripts.
verification: Customer-facing routes expose only intended tenant/account data; no internal model transcripts.

units.title: Cohort profitability, CAC and revenue reporting
scope: Combine payments, refunds, retained revenue, model/channel spend and touchpoint attribution.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Reported net margin matches auditable ledger entries and shows attribution uncertainty.
verification: Reported net margin matches auditable ledger entries and shows attribution uncertainty.

units.title: Opt-in sandbox and live payment acceptance gate
scope: Verify sandbox to production switch, authorized low-risk transaction, reconciliation and rollback.
units.acceptanceCriteria: No unapproved charge or spending; proof of settlement and refund flow captured before full rollout.
verification: No unapproved charge or spending; proof of settlement and refund flow captured before full rollout.
externalPrerequisites: Explicit owner merchant account, required processor onboarding and permission to run any actual payment/refund.

units.title: End-to-end threat model and authorization audit
scope: Review SSRF, prompt injection, tool/data exfiltration, CSRF, XSS, webhook replay and credentials.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Automated negative tests prove model/tool prompts cannot bypass policy and tenant ACLs.
verification: Automated negative tests prove model/tool prompts cannot bypass policy and tenant ACLs.

units.title: Consent, privacy, correction and deletion end-to-end
scope: Complete data subject exports, retention expiration, redaction, privacy disclosures and processor inventory.
units.acceptanceCriteria: GDPR/CASL or other enabled jurisdictions have reviewed policies; unsupported regions disabled.
verification: GDPR/CASL or other enabled jurisdictions have reviewed policies; unsupported regions disabled.

units.title: Sender reputation, compliance and abuse readiness
scope: Harden DKIM/SPF/DMARC validation, sender domain limits, unsubscribe tests and complaint threshold pauses.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Real outbound cannot enable until business profile and deliverability test evidence pass.
verification: Real outbound cannot enable until business profile and deliverability test evidence pass.

units.title: WCAG mobile/accessibility audit and repairs
scope: Run keyboard, screen reader, zoom, reduced-motion, touch drag alternative and color contrast reviews.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Key flows meet WCAG 2.2 AA target with test evidence across supported screen sizes.
verification: Key flows meet WCAG 2.2 AA target with test evidence across supported screen sizes.

units.title: Queries, caches, load and database indexes
scope: Optimize large roster, timeline, CRM search, campaign progress and model metrics read patterns.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Synthetic 100k-contact workload meets explicit baseline latency, with no N+1/O(n) UI rendering.
verification: Synthetic 100k-contact workload meets explicit baseline latency, with no N+1/O(n) UI rendering.

units.title: Encrypted backup/restore, object recovery and continuity drill
scope: Define RPO/RTO targets, periodic encrypted backup, object versioning, restore scripts and lease reconciliation.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Staging restore of real schema and synthetic records succeeds; evidence/retention preserved.
verification: Staging restore of real schema and synthetic records succeeds; evidence/retention preserved.

units.title: Infrastructure as code and isolated resources
scope: Create staging/prod infra manifests for web/API, worker, dedicated DB, object storage, secrets and TLS.
units.acceptanceCriteria: CI validates config with no paid provisioning; resource deployment requires explicit cost approval.
verification: CI validates config with no paid provisioning; resource deployment requires explicit cost approval.
externalPrerequisites: Explicit owner approval before provisioning any new billable Render/Neon/object-store resource.

units.title: Isolated staging environment and rehearsal
scope: Deploy with synthetic data, fake mail and paid APIs disabled; test migrations, auth, worker and owner controls.
units.acceptanceCriteria: One-click scripted smoke proof and rollback succeeds; source SHA and live revision recorded.
verification: One-click scripted smoke proof and rollback succeeds; source SHA and live revision recorded.

units.title: Owner-authorized production deployment workflow
scope: Define promotion pipeline, immutable artifacts, rollback, release audit, manual cost/secret gates.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Only approved infrastructure/credentials permit deployment; no spend from unapproved CI.
verification: Only approved infrastructure/credentials permit deployment; no spend from unapproved CI.
externalPrerequisites: Owner-provisioned production domain, isolation resources, secrets and infrastructure spending authorization.

units.title: Scoped real-world first outreach acceptance
scope: Exercise owner-approved low-volume permitted campaign via live mailbox/model with full receipts and suppression.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Live send, reply, opt-out, budget and agent status proven; block if sender, credentials or spending unavailable.
verification: Live send, reply, opt-out, budget and agent status proven; block if sender, credentials or spending unavailable.
externalPrerequisites: Explicit owner approval for real outreach, funded hard caps if needed, validated sender/opt-outs and lawful source of test leads.

units.title: Operational dashboard, incident response and kill-switch drills
scope: Expose worker, mailbox, queue, spend and compliance alerts with triage checklist and event evidence.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Pause-all/credential revoke drills stop dispatcher and produce incident records; alerts aren't fabricated.
verification: Pause-all/credential revoke drills stop dispatcher and produce incident records; alerts aren't fabricated.

units.title: Horizontal workers, fair-share quotas and tenant backpressure
scope: Partition job scheduling, admission controls and rate limits for many agents/campaigns with bounded inference.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Synthetic tens-of-thousands concurrent scheduled identities queue fairly without breaking lease/suppression.
verification: Synthetic tens-of-thousands concurrent scheduled identities queue fairly without breaking lease/suppression.

units.title: Million registered identity scale and cold-start test
scope: Stress test one million saved avatars/agent identities as database records, with only bounded active workers.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Paging, searches, storage and costs measured; never claim million always-running agents.
verification: Paging, searches, storage and costs measured; never claim million always-running agents.

units.title: Optional commercial multi-tenant onboarding and isolation
scope: Package organization signup/billing-ready roles, trials with zero paid calls, data export and ownership transfers.
units.acceptanceCriteria: New tenant starts empty, never sees the owner's film-character agents, contacts or API keys.
verification: New tenant starts empty, never sees the owner's film-character agents, contacts or API keys.
externalPrerequisites: Owner decision to commercialize, license original avatars, publish product terms and comply with applicable privacy and billing obligations.

units.title: Read-only Boardroom/Engine Room portfolio interoperability
scope: Publish scoped project/event summary contracts and document counterpart repo changes required.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Salesroom stays independently operable; external app cannot mutate sales data without separate authorization.
verification: Salesroom stays independently operable; external app cannot mutate sales data without separate authorization.
externalPrerequisites: External Boardroom/Engine Room consumer modifications require independently approved and tracked changes in their respective repositories.

units.title: Production acceptance, runbooks and definition of done
scope: Record demonstrable end-to-end product, funding and analytics journeys and exact blockers in durable release status.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Evidence differentiates deployed from demo, planned from merged, interest from cash; no false completion.
verification: Evidence differentiates deployed from demo, planned from merged, interest from cash; no false completion.
